words.ex: He looked at the menu and chose pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他看了菜单，选择了意大利面。
words.en: A menu is a list of the food that is available at a restaurant or café.

words.ex: He ate ham for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了火腿。
words.en: Ham is meat from the upper part of a pig's leg that has been preserved with salt or smoke.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃肉。
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: He ordered a steak for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐点了一份牛排。
words.en: A steak is a slice of meat, especially beef, that is cooked by grilling or frying.

words.ex: The main dish is chicken with rice.
words.ex_cn: 主菜是鸡肉配米饭。
words.en: The main dish is the most substantial part of a meal, typically served after the appetizer and before the dessert.

words.ex: The selection of books was very good.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的选择非常好。
words.en: The act of carefully choosing someone or something as the best or most suitable.

words.tr:
n. 鱼；鱼肉；
v. 钓鱼；捕鱼；
words.ex: He caught a big fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 他在河里钓到了一条大鱼。
words.en: A fish is a creature that lives in water and has a tail and fins. Fish is also the flesh of a fish eaten as food.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: The soup is hot.
words.ex_cn: 汤是热的。
words.en: Having a high degree of heat or a high temperature.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.ex: The kettle produces steam when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生蒸汽。
words.en: Steam is the hot mist that forms when water boils. It can be used to power machines or to cook food.

words.ex: He eats a carrot every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃一根胡萝卜。
words.en: A carrot is a long, thin, orange-colored vegetable that grows underground.

words.ex: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 狗把一根骨头埋在了花园里。
words.en: The hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates, composed chiefly of calcium salts.

words.tr:
n. 叉子；分岔；分支
v. 分岔；用叉子叉
words.ex: He picked up a fork to eat his pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起叉子吃意大利面。
words.en: A fork is a tool used for eating or serving food, consisting of a handle with several narrow tines on one end. It can also refer to a division into two or more branches or directions.

words.ex: He cut the bread with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切面包。
words.en: A knife is a tool for cutting or a weapon, consisting of a flat piece of metal with a sharp edge on the end of a handle.

words.ex: She made dumplings for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她为晚餐包了饺子。
words.en: A small lump of dough that is cooked and served with a meal, often as a side dish.

words.ex: He ate a boiled dumpling for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个水饺。
words.en: A type of dumpling that is cooked by boiling, often filled with meat or vegetables.

words.tr: phrase. 煎饺；一种油煎的饺子，外皮酥脆，内馅多汁
words.ex: He ate a fried dumpling for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个煎饺子。
words.en: A type of dumpling that is cooked by frying, resulting in a crispy exterior.

words.tr: adj. 蒸熟的； v. “steam”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The steamed fish tastes very fresh.
words.ex_cn: 蒸熟的鱼味道很新鲜。
words.en: Cooked by steam.

words.ex: She adds flour to make bread.
words.ex_cn: 她加面粉来做面包。
words.en: Flour is a powder made by grinding raw grains, roots, beans, nuts, or seeds. It is used to make many different foods.

words.tr: v. 煮沸；“boil”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 煮沸的；
words.ex: She boiled water for tea.
words.ex_cn: 她把水煮沸来泡茶。
words.en: Cooked in boiling water.

words.ex: He eats spaghetti for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃意大利面。
words.en: Spaghetti is a type of pasta that is long, thin, and solid, originally from Italy.

words.ex: She added a spoonful of tomato sauce to the pasta.
words.ex_cn: 她往意大利面里加了一勺番茄酱。
words.en: A thick, red sauce made from tomatoes, often used as a condiment.

words.ex: The meat was stringy and tough.
words.ex_cn: 这肉多筋且坚韧。
words.en: Resembling or consisting of strings or string-like fibers; fibrous and tough.

words.ex: He put ketchup on his fries.
words.ex_cn: 他在薯条上放了番茄酱。
words.en: A thick, smooth sauce made from tomatoes, vinegar, sugar, and spices, used as a condiment.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: She bakes bread every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周日都烤面包。
words.en: To bake is to cook food using dry heat, especially in an oven.

words.tr: phrase. 甜面包；一种含糖或蜂蜜等甜味成分的面包
words.ex: He ate sweet bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了甜面包。
words.en: A type of soft, sweet bread, often enriched with sugar, butter, or fruit.

words.ex: He placed the cups on a tray.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个托盘上。
words.en: A tray is a flat container, usually made of wood, plastic, or metal, with raised edges, used for carrying things such as food or drinks.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.tr:
v. 加酵母；使发酵；影响
n. 酵素；酵母；潜移默化的影响
words.ex: She uses yeast to leaven the bread.
words.ex_cn: 她用酵母使面包发酵。
words.en: Leaven is a substance, typically yeast, that is used in dough to make it rise. It can also refer to something that modifies or lightens a situation or atmosphere.

words.ex: He kneaded the dough for bread.
words.ex_cn: 他揉了做面包的生面团。
words.en: Dough is a thick, malleable mixture of flour and liquid, used for baking into bread or pastry. It can also informally refer to money.

words.ex: He put on his glove before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打棒球前戴上了手套。
words.en: A glove is a piece of clothing which covers your hand and wrist and has individual sections for each finger.

words.tr: n. 露指手套；棒球手套；拳击手套
words.ex: He put on a mitt to catch the ball.
words.ex_cn: 他戴上一只手套来接球。
words.en: A mitt is a type of glove that covers the hand but does not have separate finger openings, or a glove worn by a baseball player to help catch the ball.

words.ex: She ate a cookie after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 她在午饭后吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A cookie is a small sweet cake, typically round and flat, that is baked and often served as a snack.

words.ex: The store offers an assortment of snacks.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供各种各样的零食。
words.en: An assortment is a group of similar things that are of different types or sizes.

words.ex: The fries are crispy and hot.
words.ex_cn: 薯条又脆又热。
words.en: Something that is crispy is pleasantly hard and dry, and makes a sharp sound when you break it or bite it.

words.tr: n. 烘焙； adj. 灼热的； v. “bake”的现在分词；
words.ex: Baking is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 烘焙是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The process of cooking food by dry heat without direct exposure to a flame, typically in an oven.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.ex: She ate a slice of toast for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片烤面包。
words.en: Toast is bread which has been cut into slices and made brown and crisp by cooking at a high temperature. Toast is also a drink in which you wish someone happiness or success.

words.tr:
n. 一条（面包）
v. 游荡；虚度光阴
words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: A loaf is a quantity of bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and usually sliced before being eaten. As a verb, to loaf means to spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: Bread is a food made from flour, water, and usually yeast, mixed together and baked.

words.tr: n. 切片；薄片；部分；片段；
words.ex: She ate a slice of bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片面包。
words.en: A slice of something is a thin piece or portion of it.

words.ex: He ate a bun for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个面包卷。
words.en: A bun is a small, usually round piece of bread. It can also refer to a hairstyle in which the hair is gathered into a tight coil or knot at the back of the head.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头很软，很舒服。
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.ex: The candy is chewy and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这种糖果又嚼劲又甜。
words.en: Something that is chewy needs to be chewed a lot before it can be swallowed.

words.ex: He eats a raisin every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一粒葡萄干。
words.en: A raisin is a dried grape.

words.tr: phrase. 热狗（面包夹熏红肠）
words.ex: He eats a hot dog at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园里吃热狗。
words.en: A hot dog is a cooked sausage, traditionally grilled or steamed and served in a sliced bun as a sandwich.

words.ex: He put mustard on his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治上加了芥末。
words.en: A pungent yellow or brown paste made from the ground seeds of certain plants, used as a condiment.

words.ex: He ate sushi with wasabi.
words.ex_cn: 他吃寿司时配了芥末。
words.en: A very pungent green Japanese condiment made from the root of the plant Wasabia japonica, used especially in Japanese cuisine.

words.tr:
v. 喜欢；享受；从…获得乐趣
n. 享受；乐趣；调味品
words.ex: He relishes every bite of his favorite food.
words.ex_cn: 他享受着每一口他最喜欢的食物。
words.en: If you relish something, you enjoy it very much.

words.tr:
n. 液体；
adj. 液态的；
words.ex: Water is a common liquid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.ex: He is eating soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他正在吃汤当午餐。
words.en: Soup is a liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water or stock.

words.ex: He spooned soup into the bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他用勺子把汤舀进碗里。
words.en: To use a spoon to scoop or serve soup.

words.tr:
v. 处理；操纵；
n. 把手；柄；
words.ex: He can handle difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理难题。
words.en: To deal with or control a situation or problem.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: He eats a hamburger for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃一个汉堡包。
words.en: A hamburger is a cooked patty of ground meat, usually beef, placed inside a sliced bread roll or bun.

words.ex: Sesame seeds are often used as a topping on bread and pastries.
words.ex_cn: 芝麻籽常被用作面包和糕点的配料。
words.en: A small, flat seed from the sesame plant, used as a topping or ingredient in cooking.

words.ex: He put mayonnaise on his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治上加了蛋黄酱。
words.en: A thick, creamy dressing consisting of egg yolks beaten with oil and vinegar and seasoned.

words.ex: He ate a beef patty for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一个牛肉馅饼。
words.en: A patty is a small, flat cake of minced food, especially meat.

words.ex: He eats beef for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃牛肉当晚餐。
words.en: Beef is the meat from a cow, bull, or ox. When people beef about something, they complain about it.

words.ex: She added lettuce to her sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 她在三明治里加了莴苣。
words.en: Lettuce is a plant with large green leaves that is eaten in salads.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.ex: He served Swiss cheese with his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治里夹了瑞士奶酪。
words.en: Swiss cheese is a generic name for several related varieties of cheese, known for its distinctive holes or 'eyes'.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.ex: There is a hole in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一个洞。
words.en: A hole is an opening or hollow space in something solid, or a place in the ground that is deeper than the surface around it.

words.ex: He eats french fries with ketchup.
words.ex_cn: 他吃薯条时配番茄酱。
words.en: French fries are long, thin pieces of potato that are fried until they are crisp and golden brown.

words.ex: He eats fast food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都吃快餐。
words.en: Fast food is food that is prepared and served quickly at outlets called fast-food restaurants. It is typically less nutritionally valuable compared to other foods and dishes.

words.ex: He ate a potato for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一个土豆。
words.en: A potato is a round vegetable that grows underground and has white flesh with a brown, red, or yellow skin.

words.ex: The greasy pan needed a good wash.
words.ex_cn: 这个油污的平底锅需要好好洗一洗。
words.en: Something that is greasy has a lot of grease or oil on it or in it.

words.ex: He put the books in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进了一个箱子里。
words.en: A box is a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.

words.ex: The cow eats straw from the barn.
words.ex_cn: 牛吃谷仓里的稻草。
words.en: A straw is a thin tube of paper or plastic that you use to suck a drink into your mouth.

words.tr:
n. 饮料；酒；
v. 喝；喝酒；
words.ex: I bought a cold drink at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了一瓶冷饮。
words.en: To take liquid into the mouth and swallow it; a liquid that can be swallowed as refreshment or nourishment.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.ex: The child blew a bubble with gum.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用口香糖吹了一个气泡。
words.en: A bubble is a small ball of air or gas in a liquid, or a ball of air inside a solid substance such as glass.

words.ex: She took a paper cup from the dispenser.
words.ex_cn: 她从分配器中取了一个纸杯。
words.en: A disposable cup made from paper, often used for hot or cold beverages.

words.ex: He drinks a cold beverage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝一杯冷饮。
words.en: A drink, especially one other than water; a liquid for drinking.

words.ex: He put the cup on a saucer.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个茶托上。
words.en: A small shallow dish, typically circular, on which a cup is placed.

words.ex: She poured tea from a red teapot.
words.ex_cn: 她从一个红色的茶壶里倒茶。
words.en: A teapot is a container with a lid, a handle, and a spout, used for making and serving tea.

words.tr:
n. 喷口；水管；水柱
v. 喷出；滔滔不绝地说
words.ex: The kettle has a small spout for pouring water.
words.ex_cn: 这个水壶有一个小喷口用来倒水。
words.en: If something spouts liquid or fire, or if liquid or fire spout out of something, it comes out very quickly with a lot of force.

words.ex: He poured water into the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进杯子里。
words.en: If you pour a liquid or other substance, you make it flow steadily out of a container by holding the container at an angle.

words.ex: She accidentally dropped the teacup and it shattered into pieces.
words.ex_cn: 她不小心把茶杯掉在地上，摔得粉碎。
words.en: A teacup is a small cup from which tea is drunk.

words.ex: He drinks orange juice every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝橙汁。
words.en: The liquid obtained from or present in fruit or vegetables.

words.ex: She added an orange slice to her glass of water for a refreshing taste.
words.ex_cn: 她在水中加入了一片橙子，以增添清新的味道。
words.en: A segment of an orange, typically one of the sections into which the fruit is divided for consumption.

words.tr:
n. 茎；词干；
v. 起源于(~ from)；
words.ex: The flower grows on a long green stem.
words.ex_cn: 花长在一根长长的绿色茎上。
words.en: The main body or stalk of a plant or shrub, typically rising above ground but occasionally subterranean; to stop or restrict (the flow of something).

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: He eats rice every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃米饭。
words.en: Rice is a cereal grain that is the most widely consumed staple food for a large part of the world's human population, especially in Asia.

words.tr: adj. 煮[烹]熟的；煮[烹]熟的 v. 烹调( cook的过去式和过去分词 )； v. 密谋；
words.ex: The cooked rice smells delicious.
words.ex_cn: 煮熟的米饭闻起来很香。
words.en: Cooked food has been prepared by heating it.

words.ex: He ate soup from a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃汤。
words.en: A bowl is a round container with a wide uncovered top. Some kinds of bowl are used, for example, for serving or eating food from, or in cooking, while other larger kinds are often used for washing or other purposes.

words.tr:
adj. 白色的；
n. 白色；
words.ex: The white cat sat on the windowsill.
words.ex_cn: 白色的猫坐在窗台上。
words.en: White is the lightest color and is achromatic (having no hue), because it fully reflects and scatters all the visible wavelengths of light.

words.ex: The cake tastes delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕味道很美味。
words.en: If you describe food or drink as delicious, you mean that it has a very pleasant taste.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of noodle for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗面条。
words.en: Noodles are a type of food made from unleavened dough which is rolled flat and cut, stretched or extruded, into long strips or strings.

words.ex: He eats rice with chopsticks.
words.ex_cn: 他用筷子吃米饭。
words.en: Chopsticks are a pair of thin sticks which are used to eat food, especially in East Asia.

words.ex: The yolk of the egg is yellow.
words.ex_cn: 鸡蛋的蛋黄是黄色的。
words.en: The yellow part in the middle of an egg.

words.tr:
n. 壳体；贝壳；炮弹；
v. 剥…的壳；去…的皮；炮轰；炮击；
words.ex: The crab crawled out of its shell.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹从它的壳里爬了出来。
words.en: A shell is the hard protective outer case of a mollusk or crustacean, or the outer layer of an egg, nut, or seed. It can also refer to a metal case filled with explosive, to be fired from a gun.

words.tr: phrase. 蛋白；蛋清（鸡蛋中透明的黏稠液体，不含蛋黄）
words.ex: She separated the egg white from the yolk.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋白和蛋黄分开了。
words.en: The clear, viscous part of an egg, surrounding the yolk, often used in cooking and baking.

words.tr: adj. 破损的；弄坏的； v. 打破；打断；“break”的过去分词；
words.ex: The broken cup lay on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 破了的杯子躺在地板上。
words.en: Damaged or shattered into pieces, typically as a result of force or impact.

words.ex: She wore a silk crepe dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条丝绸绉绸连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A crepe is a thin pancake, or a type of thin, crinkled fabric.

words.tr: n. 搅炼（一种炼铁方法）；v. 搅炼
words.ex: The process of puddling was essential in the early days of iron production.
words.ex_cn: n. 搅炼过程在早期的铁生产中至关重要。
words.en: Puddling is a process in the production of wrought iron by which pig iron is refined in a reverberatory furnace to remove impurities.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: He topped his last record by running faster.
words.ex_cn: 他通过跑得更快超过了上次的记录。
words.en: A topping is a layer of food that is spread or placed on top of a dish to add flavor or decoration.

words.tr: n. 甜甜圈；油炸圈饼；炸面圈
words.ex: He ate a doughnut for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个甜甜圈。
words.en: A doughnut is a small, circular cake, usually with a hole in the middle, that is fried and often covered with sugar.

words.tr:
n. 糖衣；糖霜
v. （使）结冰；“ice”的现在分词
words.ex: The cake has a thin layer of icing on top.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕顶部有一层薄薄的糖衣。
words.en: Icing is a sweet mixture made from sugar and water or milk, which is used to cover or fill cakes.

words.ex: He ate a pancake for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一块煎饼。
words.en: A pancake is a thin, flat, round cake prepared from a batter and cooked on a hot griddle or frying pan.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.tr: adj. 有苦味的；激烈而不快的；痛苦的；刺痛的；
words.ex: The medicine tastes bitter.
words.ex_cn: 这种药尝起来很苦。
words.en: Having a sharp, pungent taste or smell; not sweet. Feeling or showing anger, hurt, or resentment because of bad experiences or a sense of unjust treatment.

words.tr: adj. 含乳脂的；奶油色的；乳脂状的
words.ex: The soup has a creamy texture.
words.ex_cn: 这汤有奶油般的质地。
words.en: Something that is creamy contains a lot of cream or is similar to cream in texture or color.

words.ex: The child ate a red lollipop.
words.ex_cn: 孩子吃了一颗红色的棒棒糖。
words.en: A lollipop is a sweet consisting of a hard disc or ball of a sugary substance on the end of a stick.

words.tr: phrase. 拐杖糖；一种弯曲成手杖形状的硬糖，通常有红白条纹，常用于圣诞节装饰或食用
words.ex: He ate a candy cane at Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 他在圣诞节吃了一根拐杖糖。
words.en: A candy cane is a stick of hard candy with a curved end, typically red and white in color, flavored with peppermint, and associated with Christmas.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.tr: phrase. 糖果包装纸；糖果外包装
words.ex: He threw the candy wrapper on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖果纸扔在地上。
words.en: The outer covering or wrapper of a candy, typically made of paper, plastic, or foil.

words.ex: She added a mint leaf to her drink.
words.ex_cn: 她在饮料里加了一片薄荷叶。
words.en: Mint is a plant with fresh-tasting leaves. It is also the place where coins are made, or the act of making coins.
